mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.description, t.cover_url, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_media tm INNER JOIN media m ON m.id = tm.media_id AND m.status = 1 INNER JOIN location l ON l.id = m.location_id AND l.status = 1 INNER JOIN campus c ON c.id = l.campus_id AND c.status = 1 INNER JOIN city ci ON ci.id = c.city_id AND ci.status = 1 WHERE tm.topic_id = t.id ) AS media_count FROM topic t WHERE t.status = 1 ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.id
